title: Existence of proper/open comparison data
statement: For an existing pro-etale compact-support package P, the proper/open system comparison data exist under the finite quotient and site-equivalence hypotheses.

proof.text: Construct the proper pullback square from the canonical proper mate, construct the open pullback square from extension by zero and its site comparison, and prove the mate, level-mate and evaluation equations by the adjunction identities and the finite comparison maps.

lean.statement: theorem exceptionalSystemCompactificationComparison_exists [∀ n : ℕ, Finite (O ⧸ (Ideal.span ({ell} : Set O)) ^ (n + 1))] (hX : ExceptionalSystemSiteEquivalence CX) (hY : ExceptionalSystemSiteEquivalence CY) (hZ : ExceptionalSystemSiteEquivalence CZ) (P : ExceptionalProCompactSupport O ell c CX.proEvaluation CY.proEvaluation CZ.proEvaluation) : Nonempty (ExceptionalSystemCompactificationComparison S CX CY CZ P)
